page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 20 shared vCPUs and a total system memory capacity of 256.0 GB, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.8 GB per vCPU.

The server is equipped with three NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance, meaning storage resources must be attached externally. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

This configuration offers a high-density memory and GPU profile, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require substantial VRAM and system memory without requiring dedicated CPU cores. The shared CPU allocation represents a tradeoff for compute-bound tasks, but the instance is well-suited for GPU-accelerated workloads such as machine learning inference, data science jobs, and graphics rendering.
